findings.message: procurement:quoteApproval: direct triple written in source models/procurement/am4.ttl: procurement:quoteApproval am4:accesses procurement:quotation — write a qualified relationship resource (a am4:Access with arch:source/arch:target/arch:inModel) instead; `aisep build` generates the direct triple

procurement:rel-procurementSystem-realizes-quoteManagementService: derived-only relationship asserted — the ArchiMate 4.0 table permits procurement:procurementSystem (am4:ApplicationComponent) -[am4:Realization]-> procurement:quoteManagementService (am4:Service) only as a derivation (am4rt:permitsDirectRealization does not list it); model the underlying chain, or declare aisep:assertedShortcut true on the relationship class
